mapper.select: SELECT id, investigation_id, model_version, prompt_version, toolset_version, started_at, ended_at FROM investigation_run WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, investigation_id, model_version, prompt_version, toolset_version, started_at, ended_at FROM investigation_run WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investigation_run (investigation_id, model_version, prompt_version, toolset_version) VALUES (#{investigationId}, #{modelVersion}, #{promptVersion}, #{toolsetVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE investigation_run SET ended_at = #{endedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
